+import base64
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL = os.getenv("OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL", "gpt-4.1-mini")
+OPENAI_API_KEY = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+OPENAI_API_URL = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_URL", "https://api.openai.com/v1/responses")
+
+
+def _encode_image(image_bytes: bytes) -> str:
+    return base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")
+
+
+def extract_tables(image_bytes: bytes, mime_type: str = "image/png", instruction: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    if not OPENAI_API_KEY:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+    prompt = instruction or "Extract all tables from the document and return structured JSON with rows, cells, and inferred row/column structure."
+    payload = {
+        "model": OPENAI_TABLE_MODEL,
+        "input": [
+            {
+                "role": "user",
+                "content": [
+                    {"type": "input_text", "text": prompt},
+                    {"type": "input_image", "image_url": f"data:{mime_type};base64,{_encode_image(image_bytes)}"},
+                ],
+            }
+        ],
+        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"},
+    }
+    headers = {
+        "Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENAI_API_KEY}",
+        "Content-Type": "application/json",
+    }
+    response = requests.post(OPENAI_API_URL, headers=headers, data=json.dumps(payload), timeout=120)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    text = None
+    if isinstance(data, dict):
+        if "output_text" in data and data["output_text"]:
+            text = data["output_text"]
+        elif "output" in data:
+            for item in data["output"]:
+                for content in item.get("content", []):
+                    if content.get("type") in {"output_text", "text"}:
+                        text = content.get("text")
+                        break
+                if text:
+                    break
+    if not text:
+        return data
+    try:
+        return json.loads(text)
+    except json.JSONDecodeError:
+        return {"tables": [], "raw_text": text, "provider_response": data}
*** End Patch

+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL}?key={api_key}",
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,

+

+        return {"blocks": [], "lines": [], "tables": [], "raw": {}}
+

+    page = annotation.get("fullTextAnnotation", {}).get("pages", [])
+
+    blocks = []
+    lines = []
+    for page_item in page:
+        for block in page_item.get("blocks", []):
+            blocks.append(block)

+                    symbols = word.get("symbols", [])

+                    for symbol in symbols:
+                        bbox = symbol.get("boundingBox", {}).get("vertices", [])

+                    lines.append(

+                            "text": text,
+                            "confidence": word.get("confidence"),
+                            "boundingBox": word.get("boundingBox"),
+                        }
+                    )
+
+    tables = []
+    for page_item in page:
+        for block in page_item.get("blocks", []):
+            if block.get("blockType") == "TABLE":
+                tables.append(block)
+
+    return {"blocks": blocks, "lines": lines, "tables": tables, "raw": annotation}

+import base64
+import os
+from typing import Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL = "https://vision.googleapis.com/v1/images:annotate"
+
+
+def extract_text(image_path: Optional[str] = None, image_bytes: Optional[bytes] = None) -> str:
+    if image_bytes is None:
+        if not image_path:
+            raise ValueError("image_path or image_bytes is required")
+        with open(image_path, "rb") as f:
+            image_bytes = f.read()
+
+    api_key = os.environ.get("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("GOOGLE_VISION_API_KEY is required")
+
+    payload = {
+        "requests": [
+            {
+                "image": {"content": base64.b64encode(image_bytes).decode("utf-8")},
+                "features": [{"type": "TEXT_DETECTION"}],
+            }
+        ]
+    }
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        f"{GOOGLE_VISION_API_URL}?key={api_key}",
+        json=payload,
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+
+    responses = data.get("responses", [])
+    if not responses:
+        return ""
+
+    text = responses[0].get("fullTextAnnotation", {}).get("text")
+    if text:
+        return text
+
+    annotations = responses[0].get("textAnnotations", [])
+    if annotations:
+        return annotations[0].get("description", "")
+
+    return ""
